notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
enum4linux-ng automates SMB/RPC enumeration: OS detection, share listing, user enumeration via RID cycling, group enumeration, and password policy retrieval. The next-generation rewrite of enum4linux with improved output and SMB2 support.

=== KEY OUTPUT ===
Password policy: minimum length, complexity requirements, lockout threshold, lockout duration. A lockout threshold of 'None' means password spraying with no lockout risk. Short minimum length + no complexity enables targeted spray.

=== CHAINING ===
Null session (no creds needed on misconfigured targets) → get user list → get password policy → plan spray with policy constraints → use harvested creds for deeper access.

=== DANGEROUS SETTINGS DETECTED ===
guest ok = yes, writable shares, weak password policy, null session permitted.
